fact: The Annuaire statistique 2023, dated June 2024, states that the 2023 monthly activity reports of public and private health facilities and of hospital care units were keyed into Endos-BF, online on DHIS2, by the infirmiers chefs de poste, by the districts' CISSE and by the hospitals' SPIH/SIM, and gives a completeness of entry of 91.8% and a promptitude of 77.0% for 2023; it gives no count of facilities keying their own reports.
title: Annuaire statistique 2023
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène publique, Direction générale des études et des statistiques sectorielles
